research.name: React Native Animation Samples
research.note: Five gesture-driven React Native samples: a scrubbable toolbar, a fanning color swatch, a magnifying icon grid, a bezier rope and an animated text caret.

effects: icon grid that collapses into a bubble magnifier around the touch point on long press and drag
color swatch that fans out in rotating layers following the drag gesture
toolbar whose buttons expand into labels on long press and scale down at the scroll edges
text caret that fills up as the max length approaches and turns into a check badge when reached
bezier rope with glow and shadow drawn between two sockets
